name: Echoes of Wisdom companion
_about: Native Equipment, Items and Notebooks with Echo/Automaton shortcuts and native held grids for update 1.1.0. Physical Right/Left D-pad holds own native selection and release. Touch jumps to verified native selections and refreshes the original carousel; sort tabs request one native sort operation. Field terrain follows native discovery, story and weather; supported locations show Zelda’s native marker. No game artwork, strings or font files are bundled.
_development: Selected native Notebook/Map/ActorSelect redesign; mock geometry reviewed. Desktop and Thor NCE field/held selection exercised; major-dungeon live qualification pending.
